It sets out how a Chain Governor may request that upgrade authority for its chain be transferred from the Security Council to an address of its choosing, so the chain can manage upgrades itself or through a third party. Under the policy, the Optimism Foundation confirms a valid request and publishes a public notice on the Governance Forum. After a mandatory 30-day notice period, the Security Council is directed to execute the transfer. Once the transfer is executed, the chain ceases to be a Standard Rollup. This is a non-fork upgrade.
